description: Located in the highly sought-after community of Pacheco Valle, just 25 miles from San Francisco, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome offers the perfect blend of peaceful Marin living and everyday convenience. Surrounded by majestic redwood trees, open space, abundant wildlife, and miles of scenic hiking and biking trails, this home feels like a private retreat immersed in nature while still offering easy access to commuting options and everyday amenities.  Filled with natural light, the spacious floor plan features soaring vaulted ceilings with windows everywhere, gorgeous hardwood floors, new carpet, and fresh paint throughout. The beautifully updated kitchen showcases granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a large center island perfect for gathering and entertaining. While separate from the primary living room, the kitchen opens directly into the versatile fourth bedroom or second living area, creating an ideal flex space for a media room, family room, home office, playroom, or guest retreat. From there, enjoy seamless access to the private outdoor patio, creating the perfect indoor-outdoor setting for relaxing or entertaining in the tranquil surroundings.  Bordering open space, the property also enjoys a beautiful side yard maintained by the HOA, enhancing the serene, park-like atmosphere and adding to the sense of privacy rarely found in townhome living. Additional highlights include air conditioning, a spacious two-car garage, and a bonus room with garage access offering endless possibilities for storage, hobbies, a workout room, or creative space.  Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a community pool, tennis courts, pickleball courts, and direct access to breathtaking trails right outside your door. Conveniently located near Hwy 101, shopping, the Marin Airporter, SMART Train, and local conveniences, this exceptional home offers the rare opportunity to enjoy nature, comfort, and convenience in one of Marin’s most desirable communities. This one won’t last!
